# Erdos.p11 — Erdős problem 11

Reference: https://www.erdosproblems.com/11
Imported from google-deepmind/formal-conjectures (`ErdosProblems/11.lean`, theorem `erdos_11`, AMS 11).

Is every odd $n > 1$ the sum of a squarefree number and a power of 2?

## Statement
∀ (n : ℕ) (hn : Odd n) (hn' : 1 < n), ∃ k l : ℕ, Squarefree k ∧ n = k + 2 ^ l

## Strategic notes
Open conjecture — prove-or-refute posture applies to sub-claims,
but the root asserts the conjectured statement itself. No
per-problem hints (benchmark integrity).
